fix(sunset): serve archive page on unknown paths via 404.html (#28)

Vercel rewrites don't apply to a no-framework static deploy — deep links like
/skills/<slug> returned a bare Vercel 404. Ship a 404.html copy instead, which
Vercel serves for unmatched paths.

Old skill URLs now render the archive notice with a 404 status, which is the
honest signal: those pages genuinely no longer exist. Verified live on
clawdtm.com, clawtm.com, and staging.clawdtm.com.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: archive ClawdTM — disable crons, add sunset page, deprecation notice (#27)

ClawdTM is being sunset. The Convex paid plan is being cancelled, which takes
the entire data layer with it — every page reads from Convex, so the app cannot
run in any form once the deployment is gone.

- Disable all five Convex crons (ClawdHub sync, categorization, GitHub author
  sync, security scan, commit check). These were the ongoing spend: OpenRouter
  calls and GitHub API polling every 15 minutes. Left commented out as a record
  and to make revival straightforward.
- Add sunset/ — a self-contained static archive page to serve at clawdtm.com,
  deployed as its own Vercel project so it never rebuilds against the dead
  Convex deployment.
- README: archive banner up top, plus a "Reviving this project" runbook
  covering Convex re-provisioning, env vars, and data restore.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
